description: The historical power-line database team publishes a public fragment of its electrical-network reconstruction for the Moscow region. Figshare provides a GeoPackage containing power-line segments and substations with spatiotemporal attributes, readable in QGIS. The same article links a 2021 KMZ display example and two illustrated pylon-identification guides, including 500–750 kV structures; these supporting files are grouped here. Each repository item is freely available under CC BY 4.0. The spatial and temporal attributes can support network-growth reconstruction and topology-based resilience studies. The full database is restricted for security reasons, so this fragment cannot establish complete regional connectivity or capacity. The GeoPackage can be inspected with the existing catalogue platform-qgis.
name: A fragment of spatiotemporal database for electric network data
